description: Chat Mode Bar — Replace navigation quick links with functional core modes (Code, Mission) and user-pinnable agent shortcuts. Modes change chat behavior, pins are agent routing shortcuts.

userStories.title: Create usePinnedAgents hook with localStorage
userStories.description: As a user, I want my pinned agent selections to persist across page loads so my shortcuts are always available.
acceptanceCriteria: Create frontend/hooks/use-pinned-agents.ts
Hook signature: usePinnedAgents(workspaceId: string) returning { pinnedIds, pin, unpin, isPinned, reorder }
Use the 'use-local-storage-state' package (already installed) with key `pinned_chat_agents_${workspaceId}`
Default value is empty array: []
pin(agentId: number): adds to end of array, enforces max 6 items (silently ignores if full), no duplicates
unpin(agentId: number): removes from array
isPinned(agentId: number): returns boolean
reorder(newOrder: number[]): replaces full array (for future drag-to-reorder)
SSR-safe: handle typeof window === 'undefined' case
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: use-local-storage-state docs: import useLocalStorageState from 'use-local-storage-state'. Returns [value, setValue] tuple with options { defaultValue }. SSR-safe by default.

userStories.title: Create ChatModeBar component with core modes
userStories.description: As a user, I want Code and Mission mode buttons in a clean mode bar so I can quickly switch chat behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Create frontend/components/chatbot/chat-mode-bar.tsx
Component renders a flex row with gap-2 and flex-wrap justify-center
Two core mode buttons: Code (Code2 icon) and Mission (Target icon)
Code button: onClick calls onCodeClick callback prop (parent handles Code Canvas toggle)
Mission button: onClick calls onMissionClick callback prop (parent handles mission mode toggle)
Both accept isActive boolean props: isCodeActive, isMissionActive
Active state styling: 'bg-orange-500/20 ring-1 ring-orange-500/50' (matches existing mission mode style)
Inactive state styling: 'bg-black/10 backdrop-blur text-foreground/90 hover:bg-orange-500/10 transition-colors shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(249,115,22,0.10)]' (matches existing quickLinks style)
Button shape: 'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] px-3 py-2 md:min-h-0 md:min-w-0 md:px-3 md:py-1.5 gap-2 text-xs font-medium'
Icon: 'h-4 w-4 md:h-3.5 md:w-3.5 text-orange-400'
Label: 'hidden md:inline' (icon-only on mobile, label on desktop)
Export ChatModeBar as named export
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This story only handles core modes. Pinned agents added in US-003. Import Code2, Target from lucide-react. Use cn() from @/lib/utils for conditional classes.

userStories.title: Add pinned agent buttons to ChatModeBar
userStories.description: As a user, I want my pinned agents to appear as buttons in the mode bar so I can quickly route messages to them.
acceptanceCriteria: ChatModeBar accepts new props: pinnedAgentIds (number[]), agents (array of agent objects with id, name, agent_type), selectedAgentId (number | null), onAgentSelect (agentId: number | null) => void
After core mode buttons, render a pinned agent button for each pinnedAgentIds entry

Each pinned agent button shows: first letter of agent name as avatar (rounded-full bg-primary/20 w-5 h-5 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center), agent name as label (hidden md:inline)
Look up agent data from agents array by ID — skip rendering if agent not found (deleted agent)
Active state (selectedAgentId matches): 'bg-primary/20 ring-1 ring-primary/50'
Inactive state: same as core mode inactive style
Click toggles: if already selected, calls onAgentSelect(null) (deselect back to Auto). If not selected, calls onAgentSelect(agentId)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The agents prop will come from useAgents() hook in the parent. Agent type from agent-selector.tsx has: id (number), name (string), agent_type (string), description (string), status (string). Only render agents with status === 'active'.

userStories.title: Create PinAgentPicker dropdown for adding pins
userStories.description: As a user, I want a [+] button that opens a dropdown where I can pick agents to pin to my mode bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Create frontend/components/chatbot/pin-agent-picker.tsx
Component renders a [+] button at the end of the mode bar row
Button uses Plus icon from lucide-react, same pill styling as other mode bar buttons
Click opens a DropdownMenu (from @/components/ui/dropdown-menu)
Dropdown header: 'Pin an Agent' in text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider with px-2 py-1.5
Lists all workspace agents from agents prop (array with id, name, status, agent_type)
Each item shows: agent name, agent_type badge, check mark if already pinned
Clicking a non-pinned agent calls onPin(agentId)
Clicking a pinned agent calls onUnpin(agentId) (toggle behavior)
Only show agents with status === 'active'
If all agents are pinned or pinnedIds.length >= 6, show disabled 'Max 6 pins' text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem from @/components/ui/dropdown-menu. Use Check icon from lucide-react for pinned indicator.

userStories.title: Replace quickLinks with ChatModeBar in chat.tsx
userStories.description: As a user, I want the mode bar to replace the old navigation links below the chat input.
acceptanceCriteria: In chat.tsx, remove the quickLinks array (Create an Agent, Knowledge Base, Recipes, Edit Tools)
Remove the Link import from next/link if no other usage remains (check first!)
Remove Bot, Database, GitBranch, Wrench icon imports if no other usage remains (check first!)
Import ChatModeBar from @/components/chatbot/chat-mode-bar
Import PinAgentPicker from @/components/chatbot/pin-agent-picker
Import usePinnedAgents from @/hooks/use-pinned-agents
Get workspace ID from existing context (check how chat.tsx gets workspace — likely from props or useWorkspaceStore)
Call usePinnedAgents(workspaceId) to get pinnedIds, pin, unpin, isPinned

Fetch agents for pinned buttons: use the agents already available from the agent selector, OR call useAgents() hook if not available. Check what data is accessible in chat.tsx before adding new fetches.
Replace BOTH quickLinks render locations with ChatModeBar + PinAgentPicker

Pass correct props: isCodeActive (from existing code canvas state), isMissionActive (from useMissionStore().isMissionMode), onCodeClick (handleOpenCodeCanvas), onMissionClick (toggle setMissionMode), pinnedAgentIds, agents, selectedAgentId, onAgentSelect (handleAgentChange)
Keep the existing Code button removal — it's now inside ChatModeBar
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: There are TWO locations where quickLinks render — welcome card area AND bottom input area. Replace BOTH. The Code button (handleOpenCodeCanvas) is currently separate from quickLinks — merge it into ChatModeBar. Workspace ID: check useWorkspaceStore or workspace-provider for how to get it. The existing useAgents hook is in frontend/hooks/use-agent-api.ts.

userStories.title: Add Pin to Chat menu item on agent cards
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pin/unpin agents from the agent roster page so I can manage my chat shortcuts from the agents view.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/components/agents/agent-roster.tsx, add a 'Pin to Chat' or 'Unpin from Chat' menu item to the agent card dropdown
Import usePinnedAgents from @/hooks/use-pinned-agents
Get workspace ID from context (check how agent-roster.tsx accesses workspace)
Menu item position: after 'Configure', before 'Pause/Start Agent'
Icon: Pin icon from lucide-react for 'Pin to Chat', PinOff for 'Unpin from Chat'
Label toggles based on isPinned(agent.id): 'Pin to Chat' or 'Unpin from Chat'
Click calls pin(agent.id) or unpin(agent.id) accordingly
If pinnedIds.length >= 6 and agent is not pinned, show item as disabled with tooltip/title 'Max 6 agents'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: The dropdown menu in agent-roster.tsx uses DropdownMenuItem components. Check the existing menu structure before adding. Pin/PinOff icons are available in lucide-react.
